traits.patientFacing: Amy mostly sees young adults with ADHD.
traits.prompt: Which presentations do you most enjoy working with, and which do you refer on?

traits.excerpt: I want them to leave able to explain the plan to their partner
traits.patientFacing: Amy explains the plan until you could explain it to someone else.
traits.prompt: A patient asks why you're recommending a plan. How much do you explain, and how?

traits.excerpt: lay out the two or three reasonable options, say which I'd lean towards and why, then ask what matters most to them
traits.patientFacing: Amy sets out the options, says which she'd lean towards and why, then asks what matters most to you.
traits.prompt: A patient strongly prefers a treatment you don't initially recommend. Walk me through the consultation.

traits.excerpt: Sleep and stress change how the medication works, so we look at all three together
traits.patientFacing: Amy looks at sleep, stress and ADHD medication together rather than separately.
traits.prompt: A patient comes in about ADHD medication but mentions poor sleep and stress.

traits.excerpt: I keep the last five minutes for agreeing what happens next
traits.patientFacing: Amy keeps the last five minutes of each visit to agree on next steps with you.
traits.prompt: Walk me through a first appointment with a new patient, minute by minute.
